report_name: ResQNet Label Quality and Target Validity Audit (Phase 1 Upgrade)

circularity_analysis.explanation: In v1, 10 records (2.9% of positive events) were generated via physical rainfall thresholds (>115.6mm + soil saturation). Evaluating rainfall-based models against threshold-derived labels introduces partial circularity. In v2, confirmed disaster events are tracked separately in `target_confirmed_disaster`, allowing unbiased evaluation strictly against verified official disaster chronologies.

descriptions.RIVERINE_OVERFLOW: Netravati / Kumaradhara / Swarna river overtopping danger marks at Bantwal & Belthangady.
descriptions.URBAN_PLUVIAL: Intense cloudbursts overwhelming stormwater drainage in Mangaluru Urban (Kottara Chowki/Pumpwell).
descriptions.COASTAL_COMPOUND: Combined high astronomical tide + upstream river discharge blocking estuarine drainage at Ullal.
